planning.voiceReason: Jon’s awkward teaching attempt lets him question his own confidence; preserve his established age and personality.

planning.desire: Give a memorable lesson and be useful.
planning.obstacle: His impressive demonstration obscures the simple task.

planning.sourceBoundary: Jon offers an overconfident demonstration at the temporary class. A teacher helps him turn a confusing exercise into a useful test of how people learn: simple physical models, translated labels, and a short illustrated story with a bear's paw and a wolf. His awkward demonstration earns a laugh; he learns to ask what the learners need rather than show what he knows.
sceneActivities: Jon assembles a small wooden teaching model; a paper wolf tumbles onto his nose. He resets the model and co-writes simple instructions. No new water used.
